rules.rows: Only Bronze rows of kind unit are read; the 9 blank rows and the 1 no_identifier row are counted, not carried (D-049).
rules.grain: One row per school_id and school_year. Rows that repeat a school_id and are identical in every published column are one school: the first (lowest Excel row) is kept and each other copy is quarantined as school_id_identical_copy. Rows that repeat a school_id and differ are all quarantined as school_id_duplicated.
rules.identifier: A school_id that is not 6 digits is quarantined as school_id_malformed (as in DepEd enrollment Silver, #85).
rules.codes: A code stored as 9 or 10 digits is left-padded to 10. #N/A and blank become NULL with their reason; any other value fails the gate. Region and province are NULL exactly when the city or municipality is, so they share its reason.
rules.recode: When the province code starts with 19066, psgc_recoded is TRUE; then each of province, city and barangay that itself starts with 19066 takes the prefix 09066, and a region of 1900000000 becomes 0900000000. A code that points elsewhere is kept as published. The workbook's PSGC names are kept as published.
rules.coordinates: Longitude and latitude are typed as DOUBLE, and longitude_published and latitude_published keep the exact Bronze text; the gate fails unless both reconcile to Bronze. coordinate_flag is missing, zero, outside_philippines, or NULL. Distances and the boundary test (S-1) are not Silver's.
rules.not_in_silver: The 58 enrollment counts (D-049), the workbook's urban/rural and income class (taken from psa_psgc through the code), and any check against psa_psgc (Integration, #44).
